core_rule: Water aviation is a mission system: aircraft + crew + tender/base + fuel/ammunition + sea state + recovery/maintenance + communications. It is not a free aircraft-total multiplier.
maturation: Improves from opening; 1942 carrier-battle lessons institutionalize re-search/role division. Treat as mature enough to matter by 1943, but event weather/aircraft availability/report latency remain explicit.

role_division.E13A_F1M_legacy_core: mature search/observation/spotting pool; detailed individual type audit remains incomplete, so do not invent precision performance beyond current bands
role_division.Kyofu: local interception, bomber/torpedo/recon denial, runway-suppression bridge; avoid full fighter-sweep duel
role_division.Zuiun: once locally ready: fast search/contact first, gunfire spotting/liaison second, opportunistic light attack third
role_division.tenders: Chitose/Chiyoda remain branch seaplane tenders; mobile reconnaissance/maintenance/support bases, not automatically converted carriers

base_defense.runway_independence: water operations can preserve a temporary local air layer after runway suppression
base_defense.attention_tax: attacker must separately locate/suppress anchorage, tenders, fuel, cranes/ramps and dispersed support

gunfire_observation.rule: Floatplane observation may improve spotting/correction only if visibility, communications, aircraft survival and target geometry permit.
gunfire_observation.working_branch_band: 10-25% improvement from legacy cross-domain reference; never auto-apply as hit-rate multiplier.

night_operations.rule: Night reconnaissance/contact/liaison may be used only when crew qualification, navigation, weather/moon/illumination, communications, recovery point and enemy night threat are supplied. No automatic night-search superiority is encoded.

anti_errors: Do not count national floatplane inventory as local ready aircraft.
Do not equate a surviving lagoon with a functioning seaplane base.
Do not treat Kyofu as F6F-class sustained air-superiority fighter.
Do not field Zuiun at 1943-10-01 merely because September delivery began.
Do not double count TECH-SEARCH-MULTILAYER and this doctrine as two independent search bonuses.
